minutes_text:
LA VERNE YOUTH & FAMILY ACTION COMMITTEE
  Minutes of the Regular Meeting
  March 22, 2022

1. A meeting of the Youth & Family Action Committee was called to order by Chair
  Robin Carder at 6:31 p.m.

2. Executive Board Members present:

  Executive Board
  Rick Crosby, Vice Chair - Council Member
  Denise Fisher - Resident
  Don Kendrick - Resident

  Hollie Savage, LVPD
  Josh Wells, LVPD
  Janessa Gonzalez, LVPD
  Ryan Lehotsky, LVPD
  Mark Rodgers, BUSD
  Joy Lindsay, BUSD
  JR Ranells, City of La Verne
  Ron Serven, Resident

3. Review of Minutes  Minutes for the February 15, 2022, meeting were
  approved.

4. School Resource Officer  SRO Janessa Gonzalez provided a report noting that
  things have been busy and that there continues to be
  mental health related issues. The group discussed
  the additional resources available as well as more
  awareness surrounding mental health.

  Ryan Lehotsky was introduced as the City’s new
  Tobacco Education Compliance Officer (TECO).
  Ryan shared his background and plan for upcoming
  education and compliance activities surrounding the
  Tobacco Ordinance and funding through a
  Department of Justice grant.

5. BUSD Update  Mark Rodgers with the BUSD shared positive news
  regarding lower COVID-19 cases and the ability to
  focus on kids. Mark noted that the BUSD was
  preparing to have summer programs for all three levels
  of education as a mitigation measure related to COVID
  impacts. Mark also shared plans for transitional
  kindergarten as well as the impacts on new state day
  care programs.
 Youth & Family Action Committee Minutes March 22, 2022, page 2

6. Community Well Being Grant JR Ranells with the City shared potential areas to
  target for YFAC’s grant application for community
  wellness efforts. The group supported focusing on
  expansion of the Summer Lunch Program as well as
  providing other educational/resource materials for
  residents regarding wellness.

  Resident Ron Serven shared information regarding the
  La Verne San Dimas Education Foundation related to
  wellness noting he would be providing a full
  presentation at the next meeting in April.

7. Public Comment  Board Member Don Kendrick shared his desire to put
  an emphasis at the beginning of the next school year
  to gain youth representation on YFAC.

  Ron shared information on the Compassion in Action
  Walkathon taking place on April 16th.

  JR noted opportunities for interested residents or
  businesses to sponsor the City’s Concerts in the Park
  Series by contacting Community Services.

8. Next Meeting  The next YFAC meeting was scheduled for April 26,
  2022.

9. Adjournment  The meeting was adjourned at 7:55 p.m.

Respectfully submitted,

JR Ranells
Assistant to the City Manager
